claims.paraphrase: KT2440 hosted pWW0 derivatives; distinguish experimental host from plasmid origin.
N-terminal sequencing reassigns the earlier benzaldehyde-active preparation to XylG. It oxidized catechol and4-methylcatechol cleavage products, but not the3-methyl product.
XylG pH optima were8.3 for semialdehyde and9.6 for benzaldehyde.
Semialdehyde kinetics were measured here; aldehyde and NAD kinetics came from earlier studies. Preserve separate assays.
XylC was purified from thexylG-deletion host and lacked semialdehyde activity. Its tetramer, buffer inhibition and kinetic data do not describe XylG.
XylG homodimer status cites1990 work; the1995 paper does not newly measure that assembly. Proposed active-site explanations remain interpretations.
